pairs: ne in furore tuo arguas me,
do not rebuke me in your fury,
neque in ira tua corripias me:
nor chastise me in your wrath.
quoniam sagittæ tuæ infixæ sunt mihi,
For your arrows have been driven into me,
et confirmasti super me manum tuam.
and your hand has been confirmed over me.
Non est sanitas in carne mea, a facie iræ tuæ;
There is no health in my flesh before the face of your wrath.
non est pax ossibus meis, a facie peccatorum meorum:
There is no peace for my bones before the face of my sins.
quoniam iniquitates meæ supergressæ sunt caput meum,
For my iniquities have walked over my head,
et sicut onus grave gravatæ sunt super me.
and they have been like a heavy burden weighing upon me.
Putruerunt et corruptæ sunt cicatrices meæ,
and been corrupted before the face of my foolishness.
Miser factus sum et curvatus sum usque in finem;
I have become miserable, and I have been bent down, even to the end.
I have walked with contrition all day long.
Quoniam lumbi mei impleti sunt illusionibus,
For my loins have been filled with illusions,
et non est sanitas in carne mea.
and there is no health in my flesh.
I bellowed from the groaning of my heart.
all my desire is before you,
et gemitus meus a te non est absconditus.
and my groaning before you has not been hidden.
and the light of my eyes has abandoned me,
and it is not with me.
Amici mei et proximi mei adversum me appropinquaverunt,
and my neighbors have drawn near
And those who were next to me stood far apart.
et vim faciebant qui quærebant animam meam.
And those who sought my soul used violence.
Et qui inquirebant mala mihi, locuti sunt vanitates,
And those who sought evil accusations against me were speaking emptiness.
And they practiced deceitfulness all day long.
et sicut mutus non aperiens os suum.
And I was like someone mute, not opening his mouth.
Et factus sum sicut homo non audiens,
And I became like a man who does not hear,
et non habens in ore suo redargutiones.
and who has no reproofs in his mouth.
“Lest at any time, my enemies might rejoice over me,”
and, “While my feet are being shaken,
they have spoken great things against me.”
Quoniam ego in flagella paratus sum,
For I have been prepared for scourges,
et dolor meus in conspectu meo semper.
and my sorrow is ever before me.
For I will announce my iniquity,
and I will think about my sin.
and they have been stronger than me.
et multiplicati sunt qui oderunt me inique.
And those who have wrongfully hated me have been multiplied.
Qui retribuunt mala pro bonis detrahebant mihi,
Those who render evil for good have dragged me down,
Be attentive to my help, O Lord,
